Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
What if vampire A plays Mind Numb on another vampire B controlled
by another Methuselah, and the controller of vampire A is
ousted before his/her next untap phase?. When is Mind Numb
burnt then?.

According to card text, Mind Numb is burnt during the next untap
phase of the controller of the vampire who played it.

MIND NUMB CARD TEXT
Mind Numb: Action, Presence, 1 blood
(D) Put this card on any untapped vampire. Tap that vampire; he or she
does not untap during his or her controller's untap phase. Burn this
card at the beginning of your next untap phase. (S) As above, with +1
stealth.

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It is burnt at the untap phase of the Methuselah who controls the minion
it is on. It is a minion card (not a master card) -> it is controlled
by the controller of the minion it is on.
